To Give the Advantage to Those Who Secure Our Future About SentinelOne At SentinelOne, we exist for those who protect what matters most. We believe security should be intelligent, unified, and always on. Human-led. AI-powered. Acting at machine speed. This is how defenders gain the advantage and stay one step ahead. Always. Our Vision A Safer Future for Humanity Humanity has crossed a threshold. AI is embedded in how we build, operate, and defend. As intelligence grows, so does risk. We are no longer securing data and devices alone, but systems that think and act. This demands a new operating model where machines scale and humans guide. Our vision is to ensure progress and build a safer future for humanity. Leadership Leading the Way in Cybersecurity Tomer Weingarten Chief Executive Officer, Co-Founder Read Bio X Chief Executive Officer, Co-Founder Tomer Weingarten Tomer Weingarten is co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of SentinelOne, the global leader in AI security, and is responsible for the company’s direction, products, and strategy. Over the last decade, Tomer has transformed the cybersecurity industry through his vision and focus on innovation. An engineer by trade, Tomer has deep programming, database, and machine learning experience which he has leveraged to develop cutting-edge solutions that bring together the power of AI, data, and cloud in the world’s most advanced cybersecurity platform that protects the entire enterprise. Tomer is a board member at identity cloud company Saviynt and serves on the board of trustees at Palo Alto University. He also advises deep learning startup Imubit, and trust and safety leader ActiveFence. Sonalee Parekh Chief Financial Officer Read Bio X Chief Financial Officer Sonalee Parekh Sonalee Parekh is Chief Financial Officer at SentinelOne, bringing more than 25 years of experience guiding technology companies through scale, complexity, and public-market execution. She leads the company’s global finance organization, including financial planning, controllership, tax, treasury, corporate development, and investor relations. Prior to SentinelOne, Sonalee served as Chief Financial Officer at Asana, where she strengthened forecasting discipline, improved unit economics, and enhanced predictability during a period of transformation. Previously, she was CFO of RingCentral, a global SaaS company with approximately $2.5B in annual revenue, where she aligned growth strategy with margin expansion and led significant capital structure initiatives, including the refinancing of approximately $2B of debt. Earlier in her career, Sonalee held senior finance and strategy roles at Hewlett Packard Enterprise, where she led corporate development, M&A, and investor relations, and spent nearly two decades in global investment banking at Goldman Sachs, Barclays, Jefferies, and RBC, advising companies on IPOs, M&A, and capital structure. She currently serves on the board of indie Semiconductor, where she is Audit Committee Chair, and is a member of the CFO Advisory Council for Lightspeed Venture Partners. Barry Padgett President & Chief Operating Officer Read Bio X President & Chief Operating Officer Barry Padgett Barry Padgett is a growth-driven executive, builder, and leader with over 25 years of global go-to-market and operational leadership experience. As President and Chief Operating Officer at SentinelOne, Barry oversees marketing, public sector & policy, threat discovery and response, advisory services, and customer success. He has held key leadership roles at category-defining companies including Concur, SAP, Stripe, and Amperity, driving growth and building high-performance global teams. Barry holds degrees in Applied Mathematics, Business and Software Engineering from Union College, the University of New South Wales and Oxford University. Ana Pinczuk President of Product and Technology Read Bio X President of Product and Technology Ana Pinczuk As President of Product & Technology at SentinelOne, Ana Pinczuk brings nearly 30 years of technology and executive leadership experience scaling category-defining SaaS and cybersecurity businesses. Prior to her appointment to SentinelOne’s executive leadership team in September of 2025, she served on SentinelOne’s Board of Directors, giving her deep familiarity with the company’s strategy, culture, and technology roadmap. Her proven leadership track record spans product and technology leadership roles including President & GM at HPE, Chief Development Officer at Anaplan, EVP and Chief Product Officer at Veritas, SVP and GM at Symantec, as well as senior executive positions at Cisco, and AT&T. Ana also served on the boards of several high-growth SaaS and security companies. She holds undergraduate and graduate mechanical engineering degrees from Cornell University, an executive master’s degree in technology management from the University of Pennsylvania, a master’s degree in software management from Carnegie Mellon University and a master’s degree in Cybersecurity Risk and Strategy from New York University. Divya Ghatak Chief People, Places and Corporate Engagement Officer Read Bio X Chief People, Places and Corporate Engagement Officer Divya Ghatak Divya Ghatak has served as Chief People Officer of SentinelOne since August 2019. She brings over 25 years of experience in scaling high growth public and private companies by attracting, retaining, and developing best-in-class talent. Today, she leads the People, Places, and Corporate Engagement functions. Divya has enabled the company’s hypergrowth and expansion plans while strengthening an amazing workplace culture through hiring with intention, prioritizing wellbeing, establishing trust, and embracing diversity. Her emphasis on driving corporate engagement through the S Foundation across the communities where we live and work enables Sentinels to be a true force for good. Prior to SentinelOne, Divya was Global VP of People at Nevro and CPO at GoodData. She has also held global HR leadership roles at a variety of tech companies, including Cisco and Tavant. Divya received her Master’s in Human Resources Management/Personnel Administration from Tata Institute of Social Science and her Bachelor of Arts in Economics with honors from Delhi University. Michael Cremen President, Chief Revenue Officer Read Bio X President, Chief Revenue Officer Michael Cremen Michael Cremen is an accomplished international executive with an extensive background in the technology industry. He has proven experience delivering sustainable high growth at scale and developing exemplary go-to-market strategy. Michael also excels at building and leading highly competitive teams, fostering high-performance cultures, and establishing operational systems that drive world-class results and business value. Keenan Conder Chief Legal Officer Read Bio X Chief Legal Officer Keenan Conder Keenan Conder has served as Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary at SentinelOne since September 2021. Keenan brings over 25 years of experience scaling high-growth, public companies in the technology sector. Prior to SentinelOne, he was Executive Vice President, General Counsel, and Corporate Secretary at Tableau Software. At Tableau, Keenan led the company's legal and regulatory affairs following its 2013 IPO through extensive growth and international expansion, including its acquisition, integration, and ongoing growth as a part of Salesforce.com, Inc. Before that, Keenan was Vice President, General Counsel, and Corporate Secretary at Isilon Systems from 2007 to 2012. He also led legal and regulatory teams in the travel and technology sector for more than ten years, and served as Senior Vice President and General Counsel of Expedia, Inc. and Travelocity.com, Inc. Eran Ashkenazi Chief Business Officer Read Bio X Chief Business Officer Eran Ashkenazi Eran Ashkenazi, Chief Business Officer at SentinelOne, is a customer-focused executive with over 20 years of leadership in cybersecurity. He spearheads global strategic initiatives, leads acquisition integration across the business, drives the expansion of the AI Security business unit, and oversees the Office of the CEO. As former Chief Customer Officer, he spent a decade building and scaling a world-class services organization, including Technical Support, Customer Success, and the Vigilance MDR offering with a 24x7 SOC. Previously, Eran led global professional services at Check Point Software Technologies. Jeff Reed Chief Technology Officer Read Bio X Chief Technology Officer Jeff Reed Jeff Reed is Chief Technology Officer at SentinelOne, bringing more than 20 years of experience leading cloud, security, and enterprise platform innovation. He joins from Vectra AI, where he served as Chief Product Officer, overseeing product strategy and execution across engineering, product management, technical marketing, customer support, and security. Previously, Jeff was Vice President of Product for Cloud Security at Google Cloud, where he led product management and UX across Google Cloud’s security portfolio, including Chronicle Security Operations, Mandiant SaaS offerings, Security Command Center, BeyondCorp, and core cloud security services. Earlier at Google, he led product for Google Kubernetes Engine, Anthos, and serverless platforms. Before Google, Jeff spent a decade at Cisco in senior leadership roles, including SVP and GM of cloud and network security and GM of Cisco’s Catalyst switching business. He holds a BS in Industrial Engineering and an MBA from Stanford University. Chris Corde Chief Product Officer Read Bio X Chief Product Officer Chris Corde Chris Corde is Chief Product Officer at SentinelOne, leading product management and driving the company’s platform strategy and innovation. He brings more than 20 years of experience across cybersecurity, cloud, and enterprise software. Previously, Chris was Senior Director of Product Management at Google, leading the Google security product portfolio including Google Security Operations, Google Threat Intelligence, Mandiant offerings, and Chrome Enterprise Premium. Earlier he served as Vice President of Product Management at VMware Carbon Black, leading product and user experience for the Security Business Unit. He also held leadership roles at RSA Security and LogMeIn, spanning product management, corporate strategy, and product marketing. Chris holds a B.S. in Computer Science from Fairleigh Dickinson University, a Master’s degree in Computer Science from New York University, and an MBA from Boston College. Steve Stone Chief Customer Officer Read Bio X Chief Customer Officer Steve Stone Steve Stone is a cybersecurity leader and practitioner with deep experience across threat intelligence, incident response, and managed detection and response. As Chief Customer Officer at SentinelOne, Steve leads Technical Services, Customer Success, and Threat Operations, which includes Incident Readiness & Response, Managed Detection & Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, and Incident Response Partners & Cyberinsurance. Steve has held senior leadership roles at Rubrik, Mandiant, and IBM X-Force IRIS, where he built and led teams spanning intelligence, response, and managed services. His insights on cyber threats have been featured in leading publications including Forbes, The New York Times, Bloomberg, and Harvard Business Review. Earlier in his career, he founded the first cyber threat intelligence team for a U.S. Combatant Command and served as a Special Agent with the U.S. Air Force Office of Special Investigations. Steve holds degrees from the University of Illinois, Jacksonville State University, and Northwestern University. Reeny Sondhi Chief Trust Officer Read Bio X Chief Trust Officer Reeny Sondhi Reeny Sondhi is a senior technology executive with more than 25 years of experience driving enterprise transformation across AI, data, and security for high-growth and global companies. She joins SentinelOne from Twilio, where she served as Chief Digital Officer, accountable for enterprise technology, AI-driven transformation, and corporate and information security. Previously, Reeny led Autodesk’s TRUST initiative, unifying security, data protection, privacy, and product resiliency to support the company’s transition to a SaaS platform model. Earlier in her career, she held senior technology and security leadership roles at EMC and Dell, guiding global infrastructure and security programs. Reeny also serves on the board of Rapid7, contributing practitioner insight and security expertise to support innovation and growth. Her leadership has been recognized across the technology and cybersecurity communities, including being named among the San Francisco Business Times’ “100 Most Influential Women in Bay Area Business.” She holds a Bachelor of Science in Electronics & Telecommunications and a Post Graduate Diploma in Management. Brian Goldfarb Chief Marketing Officer Read Bio X Chief Marketing Officer Brian Goldfarb Brian Goldfarb is Chief Marketing Officer at SentinelOne, where he leads the company’s global marketing strategy, brand, and go-to-market execution. He is a seasoned B2B technology marketing leader with more than 20 years of experience across cybersecurity, cloud, and enterprise software. Prior to SentinelOne, Brian served as Chief Marketing Officer at SolarWinds, Tenable, Amperity, Chef Software, and Splunk, and held senior marketing leadership roles at Salesforce, Google Cloud, and Microsoft. Throughout his career, he has led large-scale go-to-market transformations, helping organizations define category narratives, strengthen positioning, modernize demand generation, and build brands that drive durable growth. He is known for building high-performing, data-driven marketing organizations and fostering strong cross-functional alignment. Brian holds an A.B. from Duke University in Computer Science and Economics. Rob Salvagno Chief Corporate Development Officer Read Bio X Chief Corporate Development Officer Rob Salvagno Rob joined SentinelOne four years ago to lead our M&A and S Ventures efforts and has been a driving force in expanding our innovation ecosystem. Under his leadership, S Ventures has made 25 investments in market-defining companies including Anthropic, Cohere, Scale AI, and PsiQuantum. On the M&A front, Rob and his team have executed transformative deals that strengthen our AI and data capabilities, most recently leading the acquisitions of Prompt Security and Observo AI in parallel. His vision and discipline continue to accelerate our growth and position SentinelOne at the forefront of AI-driven cybersecurity. Her proven leadership track record spans product and technology leadership roles including President & GM at HPE, Chief Development Officer at Anaplan, EVP and Chief Product Officer at Veritas, SVP and GM at Symantec, as well as senior executive positions at Cisco, and AT&T. Ana also served on the boards of several high-growth SaaS and security companies. She holds undergraduate and graduate mechanical engineering degrees from Cornell University, an executive master’s degree in technology management from the University of Pennsylvania, a master’s degree in software management from Carnegie Mellon University and a master’s degree in Cybersecurity Risk and Strategy from New York University. Divya Ghatak Chief People, Places and Corporate Engagement Officer Read Bio X Chief People, Places and Corporate Engagement Officer Divya Ghatak Divya Ghatak has served as Chief People Officer of SentinelOne since August 2019. She brings over 25 years of experience in scaling high growth public and private companies by attracting, retaining, and developing best-in-class talent. Today, she leads the People, Places, and Corporate Engagement functions. Divya has enabled the company’s hypergrowth and expansion plans while strengthening an amazing workplace culture through hiring with intention, prioritizing wellbeing, establishing trust, and embracing diversity. Her emphasis on driving corporate engagement through the S Foundation across the communities where we live and work enables Sentinels to be a true force for good. Prior to SentinelOne, Divya was Global VP of People at Nevro and CPO at GoodData. She has also held global HR leadership roles at a variety of tech companies, including Cisco and Tavant. Divya received her Master’s in Human Resources Management/Personnel Administration from Tata Institute of Social Science and her Bachelor of Arts in Economics with honors from Delhi University. Michael Cremen President, Chief Revenue Officer Read Bio X President, Chief Revenue Officer Michael Cremen Michael Cremen is an accomplished international executive with an extensive background in the technology industry. He has proven experience delivering sustainable high growth at scale and developing exemplary go-to-market strategy. Michael also excels at building and leading highly competitive teams, fostering high-performance cultures, and establishing operational systems that drive world-class results and business value. Keenan Conder Chief Legal Officer Read Bio X Chief Legal Officer Keenan Conder Keenan Conder has served as Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary at SentinelOne since September 2021. Keenan brings over 25 years of experience scaling high-growth, public companies in the technology sector. Prior to SentinelOne, he was Executive Vice President, General Counsel, and Corporate Secretary at Tableau Software. At Tableau, Keenan led the company's legal and regulatory affairs following its 2013 IPO through extensive growth and international expansion, including its acquisition, integration, and ongoing growth as a part of Salesforce.com, Inc. Before that, Keenan was Vice President, General Counsel, and Corporate Secretary at Isilon Systems from 2007 to 2012. He also led legal and regulatory teams in the travel and technology sector for more than ten years, and served as Senior Vice President and General Counsel of Expedia, Inc. and Travelocity.com, Inc. Eran Ashkenazi Chief Business Officer Read Bio X Chief Business Officer Eran Ashkenazi Eran Ashkenazi, Chief Business Officer at SentinelOne, is a customer-focused executive with over 20 years of leadership in cybersecurity. He spearheads global strategic initiatives, leads acquisition integration across the business, drives the expansion of the AI Security business unit, and oversees the Office of the CEO. As former Chief Customer Officer, he spent a decade building and scaling a world-class services organization, including Technical Support, Customer Success, and the Vigilance MDR offering with a 24x7 SOC. Previously, Eran led global professional services at Check Point Software Technologies. Jeff Reed Chief Technology Officer Read Bio X Chief Technology Officer Jeff Reed Jeff Reed is Chief Technology Officer at SentinelOne, bringing more than 20 years of experience leading cloud, security, and enterprise platform innovation. He joins from Vectra AI, where he served as Chief Product Officer, overseeing product strategy and execution across engineering, product management, technical marketing, customer support, and security. Previously, Jeff was Vice President of Product for Cloud Security at Google Cloud, where he led product management and UX across Google Cloud’s security portfolio, including Chronicle Security Operations, Mandiant SaaS offerings, Security Command Center, BeyondCorp, and core cloud security services. Earlier at Google, he led product for Google Kubernetes Engine, Anthos, and serverless platforms. Before Google, Jeff spent a decade at Cisco in senior leadership roles, including SVP and GM of cloud and network security and GM of Cisco’s Catalyst switching business. He holds a BS in Industrial Engineering and an MBA from Stanford University. Chris Corde Chief Product Officer Read Bio X Chief Product Officer Chris Corde Chris Corde is Chief Product Officer at SentinelOne, leading product management and driving the company’s platform strategy and innovation. He brings more than 20 years of experience across cybersecurity, cloud, and enterprise software. Previously, Chris was Senior Director of Product Management at Google, leading the Google security product portfolio including Google Security Operations, Google Threat Intelligence, Mandiant offerings, and Chrome Enterprise Premium. Earlier he served as Vice President of Product Management at VMware Carbon Black, leading product and user experience for the Security Business Unit. He also held leadership roles at RSA Security and LogMeIn, spanning product management, corporate strategy, and product marketing. Chris holds a B.S. in Computer Science from Fairleigh Dickinson University, a Master’s degree in Computer Science from New York University, and an MBA from Boston College. Steve Stone Chief Customer Officer Read Bio X Chief Customer Officer Steve Stone Steve Stone is a cybersecurity leader and practitioner with deep experience across threat intelligence, incident response, and managed detection and response. As Chief Customer Officer at SentinelOne, Steve leads Technical Services, Customer Success, and Threat Operations, which includes Incident Readiness & Response, Managed Detection & Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, and Incident Response Partners & Cyberinsurance. Steve has held senior leadership roles at Rubrik, Mandiant, and IBM X-Force IRIS, where he built and led teams spanning intelligence, response, and managed services. His insights on cyber threats have been featured in leading publications including Forbes, The New York Times, Bloomberg, and Harvard Business Review. Earlier in his career, he founded the first cyber threat intelligence team for a U.S. Combatant Command and served as a Special Agent with the U.S. Air Force Office of Special Investigations. Steve holds degrees from the University of Illinois, Jacksonville State University, and Northwestern University. Reeny Sondhi Chief Trust Officer Read Bio X Chief Trust Officer Reeny Sondhi Reeny Sondhi is a senior technology executive with more than 25 years of experience driving enterprise transformation across AI, data, and security for high-growth and global companies. She joins SentinelOne from Twilio, where she served as Chief Digital Officer, accountable for enterprise technology, AI-driven transformation, and corporate and information security. Previously, Reeny led Autodesk’s TRUST initiative, unifying security, data protection, privacy, and product resiliency to support the company’s transition to a SaaS platform model. Earlier in her career, she held senior technology and security leadership roles at EMC and Dell, guiding global infrastructure and security programs. Reeny also serves on the board of Rapid7, contributing practitioner insight and security expertise to support innovation and growth. Her leadership has been recognized across the technology and cybersecurity communities, including being named among the San Francisco Business Times’ “100 Most Influential Women in Bay Area Business.” She holds a Bachelor of Science in Electronics & Telecommunications and a Post Graduate Diploma in Management. Brian Goldfarb Chief Marketing Officer Read Bio X Chief Marketing Officer Brian Goldfarb Brian Goldfarb is Chief Marketing Officer at SentinelOne, where he leads the company’s global marketing strategy, brand, and go-to-market execution. He is a seasoned B2B technology marketing leader with more than 20 years of experience across cybersecurity, cloud, and enterprise software. Prior to SentinelOne, Brian served as Chief Marketing Officer at SolarWinds, Tenable, Amperity, Chef Software, and Splunk, and held senior marketing leadership roles at Salesforce, Google Cloud, and Microsoft. Throughout his career, he has led large-scale go-to-market transformations, helping organizations define category narratives, strengthen positioning, modernize demand generation, and build brands that drive durable growth. He is known for building high-performing, data-driven marketing organizations and fostering strong cross-functional alignment. Brian holds an A.B. from Duke University in Computer Science and Economics. Under his leadership, S Ventures has made 25 investments in market-defining companies including Anthropic, Cohere, Scale AI, and PsiQuantum. On the M&A front, Rob and his team have executed transformative deals that strengthen our AI and data capabilities, most recently leading the acquisitions of Prompt Security and Observo AI in parallel. His vision and discipline continue to accelerate our growth and position SentinelOne at the forefront of AI-driven cybersecurity.
